ca395d166036.curator_note: Friday's edition of the rooftop series you keep coming back to — eight floors over DTLA, sun going down, rotating local house DJs keeping it smooth and skip-free. Free with RSVP, so just walk in early before it caps.
ca395d166036.description: Weekly Friday rooftop house party (5-10pm) at Golden Hour on Level 8 in downtown LA, with rotating local DJs.

a1aee8bcdfae.curator_note: A long-running soulful-electronic night at El Cid for $7 — the kind of low-key, groove-forward room where the selection does the work and nobody's filming. Easy eastside add to a Friday.
a1aee8bcdfae.description: Soulful electronic dance night at El Cid in Silver Lake, doors 10pm, $7.

artist_notes.name: DJ Nuts
artist_notes.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

artist_notes.name: Cut Chemist
artist_notes.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

918a63422186.curator_note: A Mochilla-style 'Like No One Is Watching' digger summit — DJ Nuts and Cut Chemist trading rare grooves with Detroit's Waajeed in the mix. Less peak-time, more for people who care about where the records come from; the Friday move if you'd rather nerd out than rage.
918a63422186.description: Mochilla's 'Like No One Is Watching' all-vinyl global-beats party at 2220 Arts + Archives with DJ Nuts, Waajeed, Cut Chemist and guests; $20.

8d2a98275ab5.curator_note: Vidiots kicks off a Bill Duke weekend with his 1992 LA narco-noir — Laurence Fishburne undercover, Jeff Goldblum sleazy, and an underrated entry in early-'90s Black cinema. Good excuse to finally try the Eagle Rock theater you've been meaning to hit.
8d2a98275ab5.description: Bill Duke's 1992 neo-noir 'Deep Cover' (108 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 7pm, opening a weekend tribute to the director.

artist_notes.name: SHDW
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

2d20ff8e0c2b.curator_note: An all-night-long set from one of modern techno's rhythm specialists, location-TBA-until-two-hours-before like WORK always does it. This is the proper hypnotic-techno end of the weekend — go if you want one DJ taking you the whole way, not the rooftop-groove night.
2d20ff8e0c2b.description: WORK presents German techno DJ SHDW (Mutual Rytm) for an all-night-long set at a location-TBA warehouse in LA, 11pm, tickets from $30.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

0f24a39aa490.curator_note: Bradley Zero headlining a Midnight Lovers open-air day party is about as close to that Sunset Sessions feeling as the weekend gets — sun, disco-leaning house, real selection, no requests. Build Saturday around the 5pm start.
0f24a39aa490.description: Midnight Lovers summer open-air day party at The Bridge with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero plus Masha Mar and LA selectors, from 5pm.

7d0bd069c0e5.curator_note: A sapphic Pride-weekend day party — more community-and-vibes than a billed-DJ night, so it's about the room, not the selection. On the radar if Pride is the priority over the music.
7d0bd069c0e5.description: Sapphic Pride day party 'Hot Girl Summer' at Untamed Spirits, from 3pm, $10.

f44b5d9fe86c.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco party in East Hollywood — a reliably fun late Saturday for boogie and classic house in an intimate room a short hop from Silver Lake. No headliner billed, but the residents know the format.
f44b5d9fe86c.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

96c73b45a50b.curator_note: A Juneteenth-weekend morning run/wellness gathering at CAAM in Exposition Park — a culture-and-community event, not a music one. Mentioning it for the weekend context, not the lane.
96c73b45a50b.description: Free 'Run The Culture' morning run and community event at the California African American Museum, 9am.

artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

artist_notes.name: AYYBO
artist_notes.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

artist_notes.name: Ragie Ban
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

6af20e062172.curator_note: The first of a three-night Lake takeover of the park, and the 18+ Friday is the loosest of them — go for the wide-open-field, hands-up version of his sound rather than a tasteful one.
6af20e062172.description: Goldenvoice/Framework present Chris Lake headlining an open-air tech-house party at LA State Historic Park, with AYYBO and Ragie Ban (18+).

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

750cc2565824.curator_note: A location-TBA late one pairing a Detroit lifer with one of the few real vocalists in house — the kind of small, queer-leaning warehouse night that tends to outshine the big rooms this weekend.
750cc2565824.description: Late-night TBA-location house party with Detroit's DJ Minx and London vocalist-DJ Josh Caffé.

artist_notes.name: FARRALONE
artist_notes.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

35bde3a221a0.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP weekly leaning disco and nu-disco — low-stakes and unpretentious, the kind of spot to start a Friday before something bigger rather than make the whole night.
35bde3a221a0.description: Free weekly disco/nu-disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with residents FARRALONE and Alex D.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer (Dirt Tech Reck, ex-Slum Village camp) — tracked artist; soulful, politically-charged techno and house from the source.

artist_notes.name: Trovarsi
artist_notes.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

artist_notes.name: E.M. Bae
artist_notes.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

artist_notes.name: 92Jelani
artist_notes.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

60356bc699f9.curator_note: A Juneteenth warehouse rave from Black Techno Matters with Waajeed anchoring it — techno reconnected to its Black Detroit roots, which is about the most meaningful way to spend the holiday on a dancefloor.
60356bc699f9.description: Juneteenth warehouse techno party (location TBA) presented by the Black Techno Matters collective, headlined by Detroit's Waajeed.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

7d3eee612155.curator_note: The strongest night of the Lake run — adding Hot Since 82 gives the open-air a deeper, more European backbone than the Friday, so this is the one to prioritize if you only do one.
7d3eee612155.description: Chris Lake headlines LA State Historic Park with UK house don Hot Since 82 and Club de Combat (Goldenvoice/Framework).

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch and Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: Cut Snake
artist_notes.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

artist_notes.name: Falcons
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

367d5cd8ea2a.curator_note: World Cup watch party crossed with a Dirtybird-deep DJ marathon on giant LED screens — a goofy premise on paper, but a genuinely stacked all-day bill that justifies showing up even if you don't care about the football.
367d5cd8ea2a.description: KCRW x Copa Del Rave: an all-day World Cup watch-party-meets-rave at Academy LA with LED match screens and DJs including Claude VonStroke, Todd Edwards, DJ Minx and Ardalan.

artist_notes.name: Ak'chamel, The Giver of Illness
artist_notes.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

artist_notes.name: Derek Monypeny
artist_notes.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

d0dd0d0bf550.curator_note: Not an electronic night at all — this is the heady, masked-ritual psych-folk corner of Zebulon, worth it if you want a left-field listening experience instead of a dancefloor this weekend.
d0dd0d0bf550.description: Experimental psych-folk/drone bill at Zebulon: anonymous Texas duo Ak'chamel, plus Joshua Tree guitarist Derek Monypeny and Kelby Clark.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Rhythm Section International boss out of Peckham — tracked artist; genre-fluid digger (disco, broken beat, deep house) and a touchstone for exactly this rooftop/warehouse-groove taste.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder of Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

82f9690b2933.curator_note: A 10-hour Bradley Zero session with two of LA's sharpest diggers warming up is the headphones-and-dancing pick of the weekend — build the night around this rather than treating it as a backup.
82f9690b2933.description: Midnight Lovers presents a long-form warehouse party with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero alongside Masha Mar, Xica Soul and Maddy Maia (5pm-3am).

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight and Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic extended sets.

404a1190c380.curator_note: The Sunday/Father's Day cap on the three-night park run — same Lake-and-Hot-Since-82 pairing as Saturday, so pick this only if the weekend night you want is already sold out.
404a1190c380.description: Third date of Chris Lake's LA State Historic Park run with Hot Since 82, an 18+ open-air tech-house party.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Eddie C
artist_notes.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

78348cab1d1a.curator_note: An open-to-close set from Eddie C is exactly the kind of night to plant yourself for — no warmup DJ, no peak-time grandstanding, just one of the slo-mo disco crowd's best diggers building the room all night. Free with RSVP makes it a no-brainer.
78348cab1d1a.description: Eddie C plays an all-night open-to-close set of disco, edits and deep house at Bar Franca.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

4fedbed9168f.curator_note: A recurring soulful-house residency in the back room of Gold Diggers — the warm, vocal, gospel-adjacent end of the spectrum rather than peak-time tools. Good low-key Friday if you want grooves over a big lineup.
4fedbed9168f.description: Recurring all-night soulful-house party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade.

bb41161eefe6.curator_note: George Miller's desert-chase masterpiece on the big screen at Vidiots — relentless, practical-stunt insanity that's worth seeing loud and projected rather than at home. Ari's flagged Vidiots as a venue he wants to get into; this is a great excuse.
bb41161eefe6.description: Repertory screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, 121 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

artist_notes.name: LYDO
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Frankie Teardrop
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

7aecfa91d404.curator_note: A queer warehouse rave for Pride leaning fast and trance-y — LYDO and Frankie Teardrop are the real-deal underground end of that sound, not a generic circuit party. Skews harder and more peak-time than the rooftop-groove lane, so go in for the energy, not for selection.
7aecfa91d404.description: Location-TBA Pride warehouse party with queer-underground techno from LYDO, Frankie Teardrop, Miracles and J.dB.

artist_notes.name: Tamara Lanza
artist_notes.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

2353e1ad635b.curator_note: The pool-party edition of Sunset Sessions — the rooftop-vinyl-house series at Level 8 that's basically Ari's reference point for a good open-air Saturday. The lineup's local-resident rather than a marquee guest, but the setting and sound are the whole reason to go.
2353e1ad635b.description: Saturday afternoon pool-party edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop house series at Level 8 DTLA, with Aplex, Tamara Lanza and Electric Field.

image.credit: Sunset Sessions / Golden Hour DTLA (official series listing)

artist_notes.name: Antal
artist_notes.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

ec2ca5e297c2.curator_note: We Own The Night marks 15 years of its no-velvet-ropes 'real LA underground rare house' parties by flying Antal in from Amsterdam for an extended set — that's a serious pairing of crowd and selector, and exactly the dirty-disco-into-house energy worth chasing a TBA address for.
ec2ca5e297c2.description: We Own The Night's 15-year anniversary at a TBA downtown location, with an extended set from Rush Hour's Antal flying in from Amsterdam.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

169931f6acf3.curator_note: Not a four-on-the-floor night — this is the Allah-Las' crate-digging crew spinning psych, surf, library and global oddities off vinyl at Zebulon. A great listening-bar-flavored hang if you want grooves and discovery instead of a dancefloor.
169931f6acf3.description: Allah-Las' Reverberation Radio crew DJ a night of vintage psych, surf and global vinyl obscurities at Zebulon in Frogtown.

cbf00da01c90.curator_note: A morning camera-and-coffee meetup for the photo/video crowd — gear talk, coffee and shooting, not a music thing. Off the main lane unless Ari's specifically into the photography-community side.
cbf00da01c90.description: Free morning photography/videographer community meetup (gear + coffee) hosted by Dangycam; address drops after RSVP approval.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

a686cbd059dc.curator_note: Inland Groove is a SoCal collective rooted in the Inland Empire that's been throwing location-TBA afterhours in DTLA since 2022 — the crowd is loyal and local, and the free-with-RSVP entry makes it a no-risk 11pm-5am add to a Friday. No marquee names announced, but that's the point.
a686cbd059dc.description: Inland Groove collective's afterhours party (11pm–5am) at a TBA DTLA location; free with RSVP before 1am, $10 door after.

f4fe507771f1.curator_note: Gold Diggers is reliably one of the best small rooms in East Hollywood for this sound — 'House and Hits' is the format, not a billing, so expect crowd-friendly disco and house from the residents in an intimate back-bar you can actually hear. Good pre-Fourth-of-July Friday add for the eastside.
f4fe507771f1.description: Groove Room's recurring house-and-hits late-night dance party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, doors 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: GG (5)
artist_notes.note: Listed DJ at Townhouse Venice; couldn't verify a public profile — local resident DJ, low footprint.

00bfe8a0d235.curator_note: Townhouse is a Venice institution for late-night drinks, not a destination DJ room — this is a bar with music rather than a proper club night. Worth it if you're already in Venice and want to keep the night going, not a reason to go to the westside.
00bfe8a0d235.description: Late-night bar DJ set at Townhouse in Venice, 10pm.

089c71f526eb.curator_note: An anime-cosplay rave at Dave and Busters — the premise is genuinely fun if that's your crowd, but the venue and format are nowhere near the lane. Hard skip unless you're going ironically.
089c71f526eb.description: Cosplay-themed rave event at Dave and Busters, 10pm; free.

9fd90f37b8e7.curator_note: The Redwood Bar is a dive with a pirate ship theme in DTLA — it's a local band room, not a destination. The Roamers appear to be a local act without a significant public footprint; very little to go on here, confidence is low.
9fd90f37b8e7.description: The Roamers perform live at The Redwood Bar and Grill in DTLA, 8pm.

artist_notes.name: Porter Robinson
artist_notes.note: Spotify heavy-rotation for Ari — electronic producer known for emotionally-driven melodic / anime-inflected dance music ('Nurture', 'Worlds'); headlining this festival.

artist_notes.name: Dabin
artist_notes.note: Canadian producer in the melodic-bass / future-bass crossover space; Spotify on-rotation pick for Ari.

artist_notes.name: Louis the Child
artist_notes.note: Chicago indie-electronic duo known for feel-good melodic house-pop; festival-circuit staple.

5b8636a94da3.curator_note: Lost in Dreams is a Porter Robinson-curated festival pulling from the melodic/emotional-electronic world he's built — more Nurture than fabric, but if you're a fan of the record it's the right context. Spotify says Porter is in heavy rotation for Ari, so the headliner alone justifies checking the lineup.
5b8636a94da3.description: Lost in Dreams LA daytime festival at LA State Historic Park headlined by Porter Robinson, with Dabin, Louis the Child, Audien, What So Not and more.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born Berlin DJ (since 2001), Berghain/Basement resident — eclectic house, techno and electro-disco, releases on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and Permanent Vacation. One of the more musically-serious selectors the Midnight Lovers series has booked.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based lifelong pianist turned DJ — Dublab resident (Hearing Color show), founder of the Planet Love queer underground party; warm, record-collector approach with deep house and techno fluency.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara is a proper Berghain regular with Ostgut Ton records behind him — when Midnight Lovers books at this level it's a late-night worth making the trip to The Bridge for. Masha Mar and James Axon opening means the room will be in good shape before he goes on.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers at The Bridge DTLA with Italian-born Berlin DJ Massimiliano Pagliara (Berghain/Ostgut Ton), plus Masha Mar and James Axon.

50e6547bec06.curator_note: Vincente Minnelli's 1951 Technicolor Gershwin musical — Gene Kelly dancing through Paris, the 17-minute ballet finale, all of it. Vidiots is the right room to see this properly. Afternoon matinee at 1pm, easy to pair with a Silver Lake lunch.
50e6547bec06.description: Repertory screening of 'An American in Paris' (1951, Minnelli/Kelly) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 1pm.

c0b91fb54504.curator_note: Stavros is on the comedians-loved list and the Wiltern is a great room for stand-up — the Dreamboat Tour has been getting strong notices. A Friday night comedy show that doesn't require much justification if you're a fan.
c0b91fb54504.description: Stavros Halkias performs his 'Dreamboat Tour' stand-up at The Wiltern in Koreatown, 7pm.

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew, OC-born multi-instrumentalist/producer — synth-pop, alt-disco, boogie and soul inflected by Japanese city pop and its '70s–'80s Western counterparts. This is a DJ set, not a live show.

c56c321b3412.curator_note: Ginger Root's records are exactly the kind of lovingly-crafted boogie-and-city-pop that fits the vinyl-groove lane, and the Bellwether is a good-sounding room — this is a DJ set rather than the band, but his taste behind the decks tracks with the source material. Free and 21+, easy way to spend the pre-Fourth Friday.
c56c321b3412.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew) performs a DJ set at Camille's at The Bellwether in DTLA, 8pm–2am; free, 21+.

d26b1c2aec3d.curator_note: The Hustle is one of Gold Diggers' most consistent recurring nights — twice-monthly disco and boogie in the intimate back room, no headliner needed. A solid Fourth-of-July-Saturday late option if you want to dance and not deal with a big production.
d26b1c2aec3d.description: The Hustle's first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: NYC DJ/producer with 20+ years in house and disco — deeply rooted in New York's club lineage, known for open-to-close sets that build from soulful warmth into peak-time tools. A perfect Midnight Lovers fit.

9412d5b2209e.curator_note: Eli Escobar open-to-close for Midnight Lovers on the Fourth of July is a genuinely excellent late-night option — a NYC house lifer playing all night is better than most of what else is on that Saturday. TBA location drops close to the event per the series' usual format.
9412d5b2209e.description: Midnight Lovers presents NYC's Eli Escobar in an open-to-close house-and-disco set at a TBA DTLA location, 7pm–2am; $22 advance.

artist_notes.name: Taylor Shockley
artist_notes.note: LA-based rising selector — club-minded pacing and modern instincts; part of the local underground network feeding nights like Information.

artist_notes.name: Luke Mele
artist_notes.note: LA-based (Pittsburgh origin), NTS Radio host — his show spans Balearic house, ambient, dub, jazz and guitar tones; home-listening and club crossover sensibility.

artist_notes.name: CHOÍCE
artist_notes.note: Part of the Information all-vinyl night lineup; couldn't verify a public profile beyond this billing.

9a0fd9893571.curator_note: An all-vinyl night in a TBA downtown space from the Information crew — the format is the pitch, and Taylor Shockley and Luke Mele are local selectors worth watching if you haven't caught them yet. The July date gives plenty of lead time; this is one to pencil in if the TBA address sounds right.
9a0fd9893571.description: Information's all-vinyl club night at a TBA Downtown LA location with Taylor Shockley, Luke Mele and CHOÍCE; 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Toronto-born, Chicago-based jackin' house veteran — 20+ years, releases on Hot Creations, Fool's Gold, Desolat, and his own Purveyor Underground label. Driving, dancefloor-first, soulful groove.

0eb89ce23c2b.curator_note: Demuir is a legit house head — Hot Creations-affiliated, Chicago-rooted, and very much the kind of selector who holds a late-night DTLA room without needing a festival billing. Certified Groovers has a track record of booking well; this is a Friday-night keeper.
0eb89ce23c2b.description: Certified Groovers presents Chicago house veteran Demuir at a TBA Downtown Los Angeles location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Gene On Earth
artist_notes.note: SF-born Eugene Albert, now Berlin-based — runs the Limousine Dream label and produces lush, syrupy minimal-adjacent house with ambient tinges. NTS presence, cult following in both US and European underground circles.

3061917831bd.curator_note: Gene On Earth is a California native who did his formative years in Berlin and built a small but devoted following with the Limousine Dream label's syrupy, unhurried house — this is an afterhours in the Certified Groovers series, so expect the TBA location and a room full of people who know exactly who they came for.
3061917831bd.description: Certified Groovers presents Berlin-based Californian Gene On Earth (Limousine Dream) at a TBA Downtown Los Angeles location, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: JTJ
artist_notes.note: Part of the Recollect Underground lineup; couldn't verify a public profile beyond this billing.

artist_notes.name: Kenny Cordeiro
artist_notes.note: Listed on the Recollect Underground bill; limited public footprint.

artist_notes.name: Matt Marauder
artist_notes.note: Listed on the Recollect Underground bill; limited public footprint.

artist_notes.name: Lavenge
artist_notes.note: Part of the b2b pairing at Recollect Underground; limited public footprint.

artist_notes.name: Mama J
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ, part of the b2b closing set; local network figure.

artist_notes.name: Max Rush
artist_notes.note: Part of the b2b closing set at Recollect Underground; limited public footprint.

1e27960536ad.curator_note: Recollect Underground runs the proper TBA-location DTLA afterhours format — tech-house and minimal, b2b closers, 11pm–5am, an IG-posted address. The price is reasonable ($11.50–23) and the format is solid if you want to dance through sunrise without a marquee booking.
1e27960536ad.description: Recollect Underground's afterhours at a TBA DTLA location (11pm–5am) with JTJ, Kenny Cordeiro, Matt Marauder, Lavenge b2b Xuliet, and Mama J b2b Max Rush; $11.50–23.

artist_notes.name: Casmalia
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, producer, and live vocalist — classically trained with a degree in audio engineering; releases on Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass and CUFF. Her 'Unicorns Only' series is exactly what she's running here: house, tech-house and techno from the rare/underground end. 'Don't Tell Me How To Rave' hit #1 trending on SoundCloud US in 2025.

31d6a23bb826.curator_note: Casmalia's 'Unicorns Only' takeover of the Sunset Sessions rooftop is a good pairing — she's a West Coast house figure with real production chops, not just a selector, and the Level 8 setting (free, 5–10pm, golden hour over DTLA) is the exact format that keeps working. Worth going even if the name isn't immediately familiar.
31d6a23bb826.description: Sunset Sessions presents Casmalia's 'Unicorns Only' takeover at Level 8 DTLA rooftop, 5–10pm; free.

aacf17a0f1c8.curator_note: A 2010–2015 pop-and-EDM nostalgia night at Catch One — 'Sorry For Party Rocking' is the title, and that tells you exactly what you're getting. Not remotely the lane, but there's something kind of charming about committing this hard to the LMFAO era. Easy skip.
aacf17a0f1c8.description: 2010–2015 pop and EDM nostalgia party at Catch One in Mid-City, 9pm–2am; free with RSVP before 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Bambii
artist_notes.note: Jamaican-Canadian DJ/producer (Kirsten Azan), Toronto — runs the JERK club night celebrating the Caribbean diaspora; Juno Award winner (Electronic Album of the Year 2024). Lush, exuberant club music that bridges Caribbean sound and experimental electronic.

artist_notes.name: Jubilee
artist_notes.note: NYC producer/DJ (Mixpak), Miami roots — high-energy sets spanning grime, dancehall, techno and R&B; one of the more interesting cross-genre selectors in the queer/club world.

artist_notes.name: Introspekt
artist_notes.note: Leimert Park-born, now NY-based DJ/producer — releases on Locked On, T4T LUV NRG, EC2A; bass-heavy club music rooted in UK garage and dubstep, NTS resident. Mixmag 2023 breakthrough DJ.

221fd89985fd.curator_note: Baile World is pulling a genuinely impressive Pride lineup here — Bambii and Jubilee together is a proper double bill, and Introspekt adds the underground credibility. This is the kind of queer club night where the music is the whole point, not just the backdrop. 188 attending on RA already means the room will have energy.
221fd89985fd.description: Baile World Pride afterhours at a TBA DTLA location (11pm–5am) with Bambii, Jubilee, Introspekt, Spiñorita and Cquestt; $11–33.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ/producer (Exhale, Lenske) — driving, industrial-tinged techno with enormous festival draw; anchors Day 1's techno stage here.

artist_notes.name: Charlotte de Witte
artist_notes.note: Belgian minimal techno icon (KNTXT label founder) — stripped, hypnotic, no-frills sets; co-headlines Day 1 with Amelie Lens.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Eric Estornel, Cuban-American techno/house producer (Ellum Audio) — deep, hypnotic club music with broad festival appeal.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Alexander Ridha — Berlin electro/techno producer and label boss (Boys Noize Records); hard-edged, precise sets.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal electro-house pioneer (Turbo Recordings) — dry, witty, body-music with a deep record-nerd foundation.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer, one of the biggest names in the Latin/global house scene — melodic and groove-forward.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Swedish lo-fi house producer (Lobster Fury) — hazy, bedroom-house textures translating to festival crowds; recent crossover.

4dd13aaa260f.curator_note: HARD Summer is a big-format fest, but Day 1's techno stage — Amelie Lens and Charlotte de Witte back-to-back over Hollywood Park — is a genuine headline booking at any scale. Day 2 goes broader (Vintage Culture, Peggy Gou). Go for Day 1 if techno is the priority, Day 2 if you want the full spectrum. Tickets on sale.
4dd13aaa260f.description: HARD Summer Music Festival at Hollywood Park in Inglewood, 8/1–8/2. Two-day multi-stage electronic festival headlined by Amelie Lens, Charlotte de Witte (Day 1), Vintage Culture and Peggy Gou (Day 2), plus 60+ acts.

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno heavyweight, Drumcode boss — precise, driving, industrial-adjacent sets; probably the most consistent headliner in techno right now.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-born, Düsseldorf-raised DJ/producer (Desolat) — hypnotic, mesmerizing long sets; one of techno's great selector-storytellers.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Alias of Dutch DJ Oliver Heldens — bridges commercial house and tech-house; high energy crowd-mover.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house producer, one of the buzzier names on the underground-to-festival conveyor belt right now.

bb4f346b7a87.curator_note: Day Trip is LA's own boutique electronic festival — Queens Mary waterfront in Long Beach, a genuinely scenic site. Adam Beyer and Loco Dice on the same bill is strong for techno; Metro A Line makes it car-free. The Long Beach distance is worth it for this lineup.
bb4f346b7a87.description: Day Trip Festival at The Queen Mary waterfront, Long Beach, 6/27–6/28. Outdoor electronic festival with Adam Beyer, Loco Dice, Hi-Lo, Cloonee and more.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Kathy Yaeji Lee — NY/Korean DJ/producer (XL/Ninja Tune) whose sound sits between lo-fi house, leftfield electronics and indie-pop; her 2023 album 'With a Hammer' crossed over while keeping its underground roots. One of the week's top bookings.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the FREQ collective — deep, dancefloor-focused selections from the LA underground.

artist_notes.name: Hu Dat
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, Lights Down Low regular — deep house and club-leaning selections.

9ea5376be5a4.curator_note: Yaeji's crossover between house-pop and leftfield club is a rare combination — she's one of the only artists who can genuinely hold a late-night DTLA warehouse *and* pull listeners from outside the scene. Lights Down Low keeps the format right: TBA venue, afterhours, proper sound. Week's top booking.
9ea5376be5a4.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji at a TBA Downtown LA location, 6/26 (afterhours); $22–46.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Detroit second-generation techno (Planet E Communications, Peacefrog) — melodic, hypnotic, soulful sets with a direct lineage to Juan Atkins and Kevin Saunderson. A tracked name and one of Detroit's great unsung selectors.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, INCOGNITO regular — deep, dancefloor-focused selections from the LA underground.

artist_notes.name: nish.
artist_notes.note: LA underground selector, Dirty Epic affiliate — minimal and deep house, club-precise.

58579f941eb8.curator_note: Stacey Pullen is a proper Detroit selector who rarely plays LA — Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO booking him for an afterhours TBA is the right format. RA pick. $27-32 before midnight is fair for this level of headliner.
58579f941eb8.description: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO present Stacey Pullen, BAE BAE and nish. at a TBA Los Angeles location, 6/26 (afterhours); $27–32.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal techno patriarch — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills, then launched M-Plant for his solo minimal work. His stripped, hypnotic 4/4 is one of the most influential sounds in electronic music. Open-to-close on the Fourth is the statement booking of this week.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, WORK regular — minimal and techno, fits the Robert Hood context.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ (WORK series) — minimal/techno selections.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ regular on the WORK and afterhours circuit.

0f729582faa3.curator_note: Robert Hood open-to-close on the Fourth of July in a TBA DTLA warehouse — this is the strongest booking of the 7/4 weekend and probably one of the top 3 shows of the month. WORK has a track record of getting the format right; the TBA address drops close to date via IG.
0f729582faa3.description: WORK presents Robert Hood (open to close), Disco Zombie, Ønyx, and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles location, 7/4 (afterhours).

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Jayda G (Jayda Guy) — BC-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Ninja Tune, Turbo); known for sets that weave deep house, Afrobeat and funk roots into late-night peak-time; her 'Both of Us' is an instant classic. One of the best selectors working right now.

7e00f46a7221.curator_note: Jayda G at Sound Nightclub on the Fourth is a proper booking — she's one of the sharpest selectors crossing over from the Berlin underground to LA club nights. $31, Hollywood, Sound's layout and sound system are well-suited for this kind of set.
7e00f46a7221.description: Jayda G at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 7/4 (afterhours); $31.

241179720c5f.curator_note: Same WORK booking as 0f729582faa3 — Robert Hood at a TBA DTLA location, 7/4. This record is a duplicate from a second source; see the WORK entry for full details.
241179720c5f.description: Robert Hood, Disco Zombie, Onyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles location, 7/4 (afterhours). WORK series.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno DJ/producer (Exhale label, Lenske) — driving, peak-time techno with massive festival draw. One of the few European techno headliners who reliably sells outdoor shows at this scale.

d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: Factory 93 outdoor block party at Grand Park — free, all-ages, and one of the year's best open-access bookings. Amelie Lens normally plays $50+ ticketed events; this is a rare free outdoor show in downtown LA. RA pick. Mark 9/26.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents Amelie Lens at Grand Park Block 2 in DTLA, 9/26 (daytime/afternoon); free.

artist_notes.name: JKriv
artist_notes.note: JKriv (Josh Krivit) — NYC house/disco DJ and Razor-N-Tape label co-founder; known for deep crate-digging, soul-inflected edits and long late-night sets. Bar Franca in Silver Lake is exactly the right room for this.

437b015f697a.curator_note: JKriv at Bar Franca is a walkable Silver Lake score — Razor-N-Tape's house/disco sound fits the venue perfectly, and it's free. The Midnight Lovers format at smaller Silver Lake spots is among the week's best casual picks if you're eastside.
437b015f697a.description: Midnight Lovers with JKriv (Razor-N-Tape) at Bar Franca in Silver Lake, 6/26 (afterhours); free.

e667ba3ea44d.curator_note: LA DISCOTECA at The Slipper Clutch — a recurring DTLA latin disco and house night in a compact venue. Free entry, afterhours, good for a late-night stop if you're already downtown.
e667ba3ea44d.description: LA DISCOTECA at The Slipper Clutch in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); free.

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: LA-based producer/DJ (CSW/Crown Sound Works) — electronic and house, live/DJ hybrid sets; part of the DTLA underground circuit.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: Co-headliner on the CSW/SLINK all-night bill; LA underground.

a2ec0d8dd081.curator_note: An all-night live/DJ hybrid set from Enayet and K Wata in a TBA Downtown space — CSW (Crown Sound Works) and SLINK run quality afterhours. The format (all night, two selectors, $16-33) is the right price for the risk on a TBA booking.
a2ec0d8dd081.description: CSW and SLINK present Enayet and K Wata [All Night] [Live/DJ] at a TBA Downtown LA location, 6/26; $16–33.

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Hungarian-born LA-based DJ/producer — deep house and tech-house, festival circuit (CRSSD, Lightning in a Bottle). MARBLE series regular.

artist_notes.name: Dylan Payne
artist_notes.note: NYC DJ, known for long club sets in the house/tech-house zone; MARBLE booking regular.

artist_notes.name: PabloDiscobar
artist_notes.note: LA DJ on the underground circuit; disco-inflected house.

4b5718ac6609.curator_note: MARBLE runs a solid Arts District afterhours — Halo Varga and Dylan Payne are both reliable deep-house selectors, and Krane (Sunday Sessions regular) filling out the lineup adds local credibility. $20-37 for a TBA Arts District night is standard.
4b5718ac6609.description: MARBLE presents Halo Varga, Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar, Krane and Highkin' at a TBA Arts District location, 6/26 (afterhours); $20–37.

artist_notes.name: Green Velvet
artist_notes.note: Curtis Jones — Chicago techno/house legend (Relief Records, Cajmere persona); acid-house and rave-era energy with modern DJ precision. Genuinely important figure.

artist_notes.name: Ugo Banchi
artist_notes.note: Italian-born DJ, tech-house circuit; modern European-influenced selections.

7c349f4a2cfe.curator_note: Day Trip's SoCal preparty at Exchange LA the night before the Long Beach festival — Green Velvet is a genuine Chicago techno legend, and Exchange has proper infrastructure. $45-95 is steep for a prep party but earns it with the headliner. If you're going to Day Trip on 6/28, this is a worthy pre-game.
7c349f4a2cfe.description: Day Trip Festival SoCal Preparty with Green Velvet and Ugo Banchi at Exchange LA in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); $45–95.

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: LA duo — sun-bleached desert house and psychedelic disco, crate-digger sensibility with a live element. Bellwether regulars.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA band blending soul, R&B and garage rock — lush, groove-oriented live sets; getting wider notice.

fd9f6e2edd10.curator_note: Camille's at The Bellwether has been quietly building a great run of late-night live events — Flying Mojito Bros and Brainstory on the same bill is a strong pairing of the psych-desert and modern-soul scenes. $24, afterhours, DTLA.
fd9f6e2edd10.description: Flying Mojito Bros and Brainstory at Camille's at The Bellwether in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); $24.

039b68263b20.curator_note: Second Stacey Pullen listing for 6/26 — likely the same Dirty Epic/INCOGNITO night (see the Dirty Epic entry at 58579f941eb8 for the fuller details). If this is a separate booking it's worth investigating, but treat as duplicate of that entry.
039b68263b20.description: Stacey Pullen, Bae Bae and Nish at a TBA Los Angeles location, 6/26 (afterhours).

61cf97428297.curator_note: The Groove at 330 S Broadway — a recurring free DTLA afterhours with house, funk and soul. Free entry makes it a low-commitment late-night option in a central downtown spot.
61cf97428297.description: The Groove at 330 S Broadway in DTLA, 6/26 (afterhours); free.

4eea8f28c93f.curator_note: Analog Outlaw's media fair at 2220 Arts + Archives — vinyl, VHS, books, collectibles in one of HiFi's best mid-size arts spaces. Daytime on Saturday, great pre-game for a Saturday night. The Analog Outlaw format (physical media + local sellers) is well-curated.
4eea8f28c93f.description: Analog Outlaw — Analog Media Fair (vinyl, books, VHS, collectibles) at 2220 Arts + Archives in Historic Filipinotown, 6/27 (daytime).

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: The Discostan party (LA) — 15 years of celebrating the South Asian, Middle Eastern and broader diaspora through dance music: Bollywood disco, Bhangra, Baile Funk, dabke and eclectic world selections. One of LA's most culturally distinct and durable club nights.

artist_notes.name: Kohinoorgasm
artist_notes.note: LA DJ collective/DJ (also affiliated with Discostan) — South Asian-rooted dance music and edits; a key part of the night's identity.

e27fde913981.curator_note: Fifteen years at El Cid in Silver Lake — Discostan is one of LA's most culturally distinct club nights, and their 15th anniversary is worth going. $11-17, walkable Silver Lake, Bollywood disco and dabke in a venue that fits the format. Easy yes.
e27fde913981.description: Discostan 15th Anniversary at El Cid in Silver Lake, 6/27 (afterhours); $11–17.

artist_notes.name: Pocari G
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ, Butterground series regular — deep and tech-house selections.

artist_notes.name: Ashtre
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ, Butterground regular — house-forward selections.

artist_notes.name: Oso Disco
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, disco-house selector on the local underground circuit.

4d5f11e375f5.curator_note: Butterground runs a solid TBA-address DTLA house night — $25 for an afterhours with a well-curated local lineup is fair. Not a marquee booking but a reliable underground format for a Saturday night.
4d5f11e375f5.description: Butterground presents Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco, Blaze Claze at a TBA DTLA/Los Angeles location, 6/27 (afterhours); $25.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffe.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

casmalia.note: LA-based DJ, producer, and live vocalist — classically trained, releases on Insomniac, mau5trap, Night Bass and CUFF; runs the 'Unicorns Only' series. Her 'Don't Tell Me How To Rave' hit #1 trending on SoundCloud US in 2025.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew, OC-born multi-instrumentalist/producer — synth-pop, alt-disco, boogie and soul inflected by Japanese city pop and its '70s–'80s Western counterparts. DJ set at Bellwether 7/3.

eli escobar.note: NYC DJ/producer with 20+ years in house and disco — deeply rooted in New York's club lineage, known for open-to-close sets that build from soulful warmth into peak-time tools.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Italian-born Berlin DJ (since 2001), Berghain/Basement resident — eclectic house, techno and electro-disco, releases on Live at Robert Johnson, Ostgut Ton and Permanent Vacation.

gene on earth.note: SF-born Eugene Albert, Berlin-based — runs the Limousine Dream label; lush, syrupy minimal-adjacent house with ambient tinges. NTS presence, cult following in US and European underground circles.

demuir.note: Toronto-born, Chicago-based jackin' house veteran — 20+ years, releases on Hot Creations, Fool's Gold, Desolat, and his own Purveyor Underground label. Driving, dancefloor-first, soulful groove.

james axon.note: LA-based lifelong pianist turned DJ — Dublab resident (Hearing Color show), founder of the Planet Love queer underground party; warm, record-collector approach with deep house and techno fluency.

taylor shockley.note: LA-based rising selector — club-minded pacing and modern instincts; part of the local underground network feeding nights like Information.

luke mele.note: LA-based (Pittsburgh origin), NTS Radio host — his show spans Balearic house, ambient, dub, jazz and guitar tones; home-listening and club crossover sensibility.

bambii.note: Jamaican-Canadian DJ/producer (Kirsten Azan), Toronto — runs the JERK club night celebrating the Caribbean diaspora; Juno Award winner (Electronic Album of the Year 2024). Bridges Caribbean sound and experimental club music.

jubilee.note: NYC producer/DJ (Mixpak), Miami roots — high-energy sets spanning grime, dancehall, techno and R&B; one of the more interesting cross-genre selectors in the queer/club world.

introspekt.note: Leimert Park-born, now NY-based DJ/producer — releases on Locked On, T4T LUV NRG, EC2A; bass-heavy club music rooted in UK garage and dubstep, NTS resident. Mixmag 2023 breakthrough DJ.

porter robinson.note: Electronic producer known for emotionally-driven melodic/anime-inflected dance music ('Nurture', 'Worlds') — Spotify heavy rotation for Ari. Headlining Lost in Dreams LA.

dabin.note: Canadian producer in the melodic-bass / future-bass crossover space; Spotify on-rotation pick for Ari.

yaeji.note: Kathy Yaeji Lee — NY/Korean DJ/producer (XL Recordings, Ninja Tune) whose sound bridges lo-fi house, leftfield electronics and indie-pop; 2023 album 'With a Hammer' crossed over without losing underground credibility.

stacey pullen.note: Detroit techno second generation (Planet E Communications, Peacefrog) — melodic, hypnotic, soulful sets with a direct lineage to Juan Atkins and Kevin Saunderson. One of Detroit's great unsung selectors.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal techno patriarch — co-founded Underground Resistance, then launched M-Plant for his stripped, hypnotic solo minimal work. One of the most influential figures in electronic music.

jayda g.note: Jayda Guy — BC-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Ninja Tune, Turbo); sets weave deep house, Afrobeat and funk roots into late-night peak-time. 'Both of Us' is a classic. One of the best selectors working.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno DJ/producer (Exhale label, Lenske) — driving, industrial-tinged peak-time techno with enormous festival draw; one of the biggest names in European techno.

jkriv.note: Josh Krivit — NYC house/disco DJ and Razor-N-Tape label co-founder; deep crate-digging, soul-inflected edits and long late-night sets.

green velvet.note: Curtis Jones — Chicago techno/house legend (Relief Records, Cajmere persona); acid-house and rave-era energy with modern DJ precision. Genuinely foundational figure.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno heavyweight, Drumcode label boss — precise, driving, industrial-adjacent sets; probably the most consistent headliner in techno.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-born, Düsseldorf-raised DJ/producer (Desolat label) — hypnotic, mesmerizing long sets; one of techno's great selector-storytellers.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian minimal techno icon, KNTXT label founder — stripped, hypnotic, no-frills sets; co-headlines with Amelie Lens at HARD Summer Day 1.

maceo plex.note: Eric Estornel — Cuban-American techno/house producer (Ellum Audio); deep, hypnotic club music with broad festival appeal.

flying mojito bros.note: LA duo — sun-bleached desert house and psychedelic disco, crate-digger sensibility with a live element. Bellwether regulars.

discostan.note: LA's premier South Asian, Middle Eastern and diaspora dance night — 15 years of Bollywood disco, dabke, Bhangra and eclectic world selections. One of the most culturally distinct club nights in the city.

halo varga.note: Hungarian-born, LA-based DJ/producer — deep house and tech-house, festival circuit (CRSSD, Lightning in a Bottle). MARBLE series regular.

cloonee.note: UK tech-house producer, one of the buzzier names on the underground-to-festival pipeline; driving, groove-forward sets.
